title: Probabilistic Symbolic-Distillation Model of Droplet Collision for Spray Simulation at High Ambient Pressures
abstract: arXiv:2609.37202v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Droplet collision governs droplet population dynamics in many chemical engineering processes, such as spray drying, spray cooling, agricultural spraying, and combustion. Existing analytical models impose deterministic, pairwise boundaries between collision outcomes, whereas machine-learning classifiers lack the explicit functional form required of analytical collision submodels. In this study, we develop a probabilistic symbolic-distillation model using nearly forty thousand experimental events spanning eight regimes and five dimensionless parameters, including over five thousand data for ambient pressure up to 50 atm. A machine-learning teacher learns the joint outcome-probability landscape from these data, and symbolic regression subsequently distils it into eight class-specific expressions that jointly define a coupled analytical model. translated_title: 用于高环境压力喷雾模拟的液滴碰撞概率符号蒸馏模型
translated_abstract: 液滴碰撞控制着许多化学工程过程中的液滴群动力学行为，例如喷雾干燥、喷雾冷却、农业喷洒和燃烧。现有的解析模型在碰撞结果之间施加了确定性的、成对的边界，而机器学习分类器则缺乏解析碰撞子模型所要求的显式函数形式。在这项研究中，我们基于近四万个实验事件开发了一个概率符号蒸馏模型，这些事件涵盖八种碰撞状态和五个无量纲参数，其中包括超过五千个环境压力高达50个大气压的数据。机器学习教师模型从这些数据中学习联合结果概率分布图景，随后符号回归将其蒸馏为八个类别专属的解析表达式，共同构成一个耦合的解析模型。所得的解析场用有限宽度的模糊边界取代了突变的状态切换。
tldr: 该研究将近四万个液滴碰撞实验数据（涵盖高达50个大气压的环境压力）通过机器学习与符号回归蒸馏为八个解析表达式，构建了首个用模糊边界取代传统确定性边界的概率性液滴碰撞解析模型。
en_tdlr: This study distills nearly forty thousand droplet collision experimental events spanning ambient pressures up to 50 atm into eight analytical symbolic expressions via machine learning and symbolic regression, establishing the first probabilistic collision model that replaces deterministic regime boundaries with finite-width fuzzy boundaries.
